And of course, to our generous and ever-supportive Ates, @Chrissy and @Rabinbliss, grabe kayo. You’re the heartbeat behind these upcoming MOA-EDSA fan projects. Hindi biro ang effort and love na binubuhos ninyo, and we see it, we feel it. We love you!

Have a great day or night Dabins! Don't forget to thank the Lord, always. 💙
